tiers.text: Ask the agent to attack your code, not just agree with it.

Try: 'Use a subagent to write about ten small mutants of my binning.py as separate copies, run my tests against each, and show the commands and output. Do not touch my real src/.' Then review each survivor by hand.

Add a `## Mutation report` section to LOG.md listing each mutant, killed or survived, and whether a survivor is a real gap or an equivalent mutant. Then ask the agent which tests are redundant and pick one to delete for the reflection.
